items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: That was Bill Johnson's outfit. ... Now, Bill Johnson's outfit was the first colored Dixieland outfit.

ctx.x: Of course, I've heard a lot of those groups too in the last 20, 30 years and so. But when you first came to Chicago, was there any of that type of music here? Is that what you call the Dixieland type? Or did it compare at all?

Oh yes, the original Dixieland outfit had been here. That was the outfit. The first outfit that came from Chicago and played here before the colored Dixieland outfit came here. That was Bill Johnson's outfit.
